content: Slept badly again. I keep waking up at 3am thinking about the conversation with dad on Sunday. He didn't even raise his voice — that's almost worse. I'm 31 and I still feel like the kid who hasn't measured up. I told myself last year I wouldn't let his opinion mean this much. I'm not sure I believed it then either.

Good day. Walked with Sarah at lunch — first time in weeks. She asked how the job hunt was going and I almost lied. I told her the truth, that I've been frozen for two months. She didn't fix it, just listened, and I felt lighter. Why do I keep forgetting that talking to people I trust helps? I want to be the kind of friend who asks for help before I'm drowning.
Got the email about the role at K. I should be excited. Mostly I'm afraid of telling dad if I take it because it's a step sideways and not up. Why is my first thought always what he'll think?

I prayed today. First time since Easter. Not for anything specific, just sat in the car after the grocery run. Felt foolish at first and then quiet. I don't know what I believe right now. I just know I miss the quiet.

Couldn't sleep. Bought another book I won't read. Three since March. I do this every time I'm stressed — buy things instead of dealing with things. It's not the money, it's the avoiding. I want to be the kind of person who can sit with discomfort without reaching for a distraction.
Sarah's birthday is next Tuesday. I almost forgot last year. I'm setting a reminder this time. The people who matter shouldn't have to remind me they exist.
